messages.subject: Re: How to specify occasion per session
parts:
By default make.capthist() and read.capthist() assume that the final occasion (and hence the number of occasions) is the largest occasion in your capture dataset. However, both functions have argument 'noccasions' that may be used to specify the number of occasions, with exactly your situation in mind. For multi-session data the noccasions argument can be a vector with one number per session.

On Thu, Sep 21, 2023 at 7:54 AM Ashley Lynn <lynnas...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi All,

I am running multi sessions (7 in total), with either 3 or 4 occasions. My problem is that one of my sessions only has a detection from occasion 1, but I still visited on occasion 2 and 3. 

So in the summary it assumes that session 4 only had 1 occasion.
 

Is there a way to create a command that tells it what sessions have what occasions? I've played around with list= but nothing I do secr likes. 

This is proximity type data. 

Thank you,Ashley
